description: This file defines a constant array 'COUNTRIES' containing country code and name pairs, used for dropdown selections in a frontend application. It also includes a utility function 'getCountryName' to retrieve the country name from a given code. The data matches backend definitions in Django, indicating synchronization between frontend and backend country representations.

methods.name: getCountryName(code)
methods.description: Returns the name of the country corresponding to the given country code; if not found, returns the input code.
